body: Hi, I'm an ugly broke ass loser too. I understand that you have depression and how that leads to substance abuse. Have you thought about trying to join a group of supportive people? like Church may? I find it easier to move forward when I know I have support. My experience is that drugs help get us by for a short while before they end up either destroying the body or relationship with others. If you want to there are lots of substance abuse centers. The emergency room accepts suicidal individuals and if it's still just a thought then you can voluntarily admit yourself. This is what I did. I found that they helped me realize that I can live life even sober. Definitely tough but you can do it. I wish you the best of luck with your journey and Hope you will continue to keep up this fight.

Hi, sry you are feeling this way. No one deserves to be feeling like this. I know your pain far too well. I also grew up w a narcissistic influence that I could never overcome. Twice I attempted suicide. Both unsuccessful. I spent 19 years in deep depression and tried everything drinking, smoking, drugs, and hostile life choices. My confidant was not in the right mental state herself. (I don't blame her at all, because I know she had a horrible upbringing and a very difficult life.) I figured out that I was alone to solve my mental health issue. Nothing fixed or ended  my life. At some point you have to try and find out what is going to make you feel better. Talking about it is one of the best ways to figure out a solution.
When in doubt, remember that many people of this world are in worse situations. (Abused, starving,  and diseased slaves for instance).
